checkpoint.pairing: Same eligible seed set across cap settings; shop comparisons are unpaired because purchases and pool use desynchronize draws.
checkpoint.population: Five-tribe lobbies conditioned on including Birds and Fairies; one committed seat per written line plus four blind Hard seats. Other three tribes follow the actual seeded game rotation. Not the unconditional shipped lobby population.
checkpoint.starting_labels: All line grouping uses immutable starting line; final line is retained separately.
checkpoint.survival: Round summaries contain surviving seats only, with counts and R14 survival reported. No zero imputation. Whole-lobby seed bootstrap retains empty/eliminated clusters.
